description: This file defines embedded templates for multiple programming languages (Python, Go, TypeScript) and provides functions to access and retrieve templates and their associated file paths. It mainly manages embedded template files and exposes utility functions to retrieve templates, get files for a specific language, read file contents, and list supported languages.

classes.name: TemplateData
classes.description: A struct that holds data to be passed into the templates, including project information, author details, and language.

methods.name: GetTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a specific template by its filename within the embedded filesystem.

methods.name: GetTemplateFiles
methods.description: Returns a map of template source paths to their destination paths for the specified language.

methods.name: ReadTemplateContent
methods.description: Reads and returns the raw content of a specified embedded template file.

methods.name: GetSupportedLanguages
methods.description: Returns a list of supported programming languages for templates.
